name: Calibre-Web
description: Calibre-Web is a web interface for browsing, reading, and downloading ebooks from a Calibre library. Self-host it on your own server with Dokploy, which deploys Calibre-Web as a Docker Compose service in a few clicks.
seoDescription: Web interface for browsing your ebook library. Deploy Calibre-Web with Docker Compose on Dokploy – requires an existing Calibre database.
